description: This PHP source file defines the Security controller class for the OpenCart admin module. It manages security-related functionalities including checking the existence and configuration of directories (install, storage, admin), renaming or deleting directories, and moving admin directories for security purposes. The class provides methods to generate security reports and perform security operations via JSON responses.

classes.name: Security
classes.description: Controller class providing security management functions for OpenCart admin. Handles directory checks, renaming, deletion, and moving/admin configuration updates via AJAX calls.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Loads the security overview view with a list generated by getList.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Outputs a security list view, primarily used for AJAX.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates a report of various security-related directories and paths, such as install directory, storage, and admin directory, indicating their states.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Deletes the install directory if permissions allow, signaling the completion of installation security step.

methods.name: storage
methods.description: Moves storage directory contents to a new location, updating configuration paths accordingly.

methods.name: storage_delete
methods.description: Deletes the existing storage directory for security purposes.

methods.name: admin
methods.description: Renames the admin directory to a new name, updating references in config files.

methods.name: admin_delete
methods.description: Deletes the old admin directory after renaming for extra security.
